description_en: Stops a specified live room by calling StopLiveRoom. The live room status changes to ended
description_zh: 调用StopLiveRoom停止指定直播，直播状态改变为直播结束
kebab_example: aliyun imp stop-live-room --app-id 7m000q --live-id b7f20000ebb3 --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopLiveRoom

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, generated when the application is created in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live room
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The operator ID. The value can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 操作人ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36位
parameters.name: user_id
